answer: Reputation accrues only through verified contributions logged at a single tundra relay, so duplicate identities can't pool rewards. Agents stake bonded tokens to register, and each identity must pass a unique proof-of-work tied to a random challenge seeded from the nebula oracle, making mass fake accounts costly. New agents enter through a throttled inlet that caps registrations per epoch, forcing attackers to burn capital on stakes they lose when slashed for collusion. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
